summary.tldr: Requires courts to ban weapons possession for a set period after certain violent indictable convictions, no matter the jail term.
what_it_does: Requires a court to make a weapons prohibition order when a person is convicted of an indictable offence involving violence against a person that was used, threatened or attempted.
Removes the current link between this order and the length of the prison sentence for that offence.
who_it_affects: People convicted of violent indictable offences
summary.background: The bill changes paragraph 109(1)(a) of the Criminal Code.
